review.notes:
링띵동 (Link Ding Dong) is a personal "read it later" app: save a link, get an AI summary, get an email reminder on a date you choose, and find it again later.

1. SIGN-IN - NO DEMO ACCOUNT NEEDED
The app requires sign-in and shows nothing before it. On the first screen, tap the third button "Apple로 계속하기" (Continue with Apple): an account is created instantly - no password, no email verification, which is why no credentials can be or need to be provided. Kakao and Google also work, but a Kakao account is in practice only available in Korea, so please use Apple.

2. HOW TO TEST THE MAIN FEATURES
a. After signing in you land on the home screen, empty for a new account.
b. Tap the round + button at the bottom center.
c. Paste any public https URL, for example https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bookmark_(digital). In the same sheet you can pick a folder, set a reminder date and add a private memo.
d. Tap "저장" (Save). The link appears on the home screen; our server fills in the title, thumbnail and AI summary within a few seconds - pull the home screen down to refresh.
e. Tap the card for the link detail: AI summary, memo, reminder, favorite. The ↗ button opens the original page in Safari.
f. Search: magnifier icon at the top right of the home screen. Folders: the "보관함" (Archive) tab.
g. Share extension: in Safari, tap Share and choose 링띵동 to save the page without leaving Safari.

3. ACCOUNT DELETION
설정 (Settings, gear icon at the top right of the home screen) > 회원 탈퇴 (Delete account) > 탈퇴하기, then confirm. Deletion completes inside the app and returns to the sign-in screen.

4. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
People save articles they mean to read and never return to them. The app makes saved links findable and brings them back: AI summaries, email reminders on a chosen date, meaning-based search, folders, and a share extension. Audience: Korean-speaking adults who save a lot of reading material. A single-user personal utility - no social features, free, no advertising, no in-app purchases.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Authentication: Sign in with Apple, Google Sign-In, Kakao Login. We receive only an email address.
- AI: OpenAI API - gpt-5.4-mini for summaries and tags, text-embedding-3-large for search embeddings. Sent data is the saved URL, the page title/description/text and the search query; no account information. Not used for model training, retained at most 30 days.
- Page collection: our backend fetches public page metadata and text; for X and Instagram pages we use TinyFish (United States).
- Infrastructure: AWS, Seoul region - Lightsail (server, database), SQS (link analysis queue), SES (reminder emails), S3 and CloudFront (images).
- No analytics SDK, no advertising SDK, no tracking, no payment processor, no crash reporting.
- No push notifications: reminders are emailed to the account address, which is why the app never asks for notification permission.

6. USER CONTENT, PAID CONTENT, REGIONS
Saved links, memos and folders are private to the account that created them and are never visible to another user - there is no feed, profile, comment or message - so there is no shared content to report or block. There are no in-app purchases or paid features. The app behaves identically in every region with no geo-gating; the interface is Korean only.

7. THIRD-PARTY CONTENT AND REGULATION
Users choose and provide each URL. We store only public metadata (title, Open Graph description and image) plus a short AI summary, visible only to the account that saved it - no public feed, no sharing between users, no republication of article text. Opening a link hands the URL to Safari, so the article is read on the publisher's own site. The app is not in a regulated industry (no finance, health, gambling or dating features).

ko.title: 링띵동 - 링크 저장과 재발견
ko.subtitle: 저장한 링크, 다시 꺼내 읽어요
ko.promoText: 저장하고 잊었던 링크, 링띵동이 다시 꺼내드려요
ko.description:
저장해두고 결국 다시 못 본 링크, 몇 개나 쌓여 있으세요?
링띵동은 저장한 링크를 필요한 순간 다시 꺼내주는 앱이에요.

원하는 순간 메일로 다시 알림을 받고, 홈에서 잊고 있던 콘텐츠를 자연스럽게 다시 만나보세요.
저장하고 잊어버리는 대신, 필요할 때 다시 찾고 활용할 수 있도록 도와드려요.

[주요 기능]

• 쉬운 공유
공유 버튼 한 번으로 링크를 바로 저장해요.

• 리마인드 메일
원하는 날짜에 저장한 링크를 이메일로 다시 알려드려요.

• 홈에서 재발견
잊고 있던 링크도 홈에서 자연스럽게 다시 만나요.

• 빠른 링크 검색
제목, AI 요약, 태그로 필요한 링크를 빠르게 찾아요.

• AI 링크 요약
긴 콘텐츠도 핵심 내용만 빠르게 확인해요.

• 폴더 정리
폴더 이름과 색상을 내 방식대로 정리해요.

저장만 하고 잊어버렸던 링크, 이제 링띵동에서 다시 만나보세요.
ko.releaseNotes:
링띵동의 첫 번째 버전이에요.

· 보던 화면에서 공유 버튼으로 바로 링크를 저장해요
· 저장한 링크의 제목·이미지·AI 요약을 자동으로 정리해요
· 다시 볼 날짜를 정하면 그날 이메일로 알려드려요
· 내용까지 이해하는 검색으로 저장한 링크를 찾아요
· 폴더로 묶어서 한곳에 모아봐요
